def bitwiseOr {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Nat n) : Vector Nat n :=
  Vector.ofFn fun i => a[i] ||| b[i]

theorem bitwiseOr_spec {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Nat n) :
  (bitwiseOr a b).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, (bitwiseOr a b)[i] = a[i] ||| b[i] := by
  dsimp [bitwiseOr]
  constructor
  · exact (Vector.ofFn (fun i => a[i] ||| b[i])).length_toList
  · intro i
    simp [Vector.ofFn]

def bitwiseXor {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Nat n) : Vector Nat n :=
  Vector.ofFn fun i => a[i] ^^^ b[i]

theorem bitwiseXor_spec {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Nat n) :
  (bitwiseXor a b).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, (bitwiseXor a b)[i] = a[i] ^^^ b[i] := by
  dsimp [bitwiseXor]
  constructor
  · -- length of List.ofFn is definitionally n
    simp
  · -- Vector.ofFn yields the function pointwise
    intro i
    simp

def copy {n : Nat} (arr : Vector Int n) : Vector Int n :=
  arr

theorem copy_spec {n : Nat} (arr : Vector Int n) :
  (copy arr).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, (copy arr)[i] = arr[i] := by
  dsimp [copy]
  constructor
  · exact arr.length_toList
  · intro i; rfl

def np_isclose {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) (tol : Int) : Vector Bool n :=
  Vector.ofFn fun i => if -tol < a[i] - b[i] ∧ a[i] - b[i] < tol then true else false

theorem np_isclose_spec {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) (tol : Int)
  (h1 : n > 0)
  (h2 : tol > 0) :
  let ret := np_isclose a b tol
  (ret.toList.length = n) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, if -tol < a[i] - b[i] ∧ a[i] - b[i] < tol then ret[i] = true else ret[i] = false) := by
  dsimp [np_isclose]
  constructor
  · simp
  · intro i; simp

def shiftLeftInt (x : Int) (shift : Nat) : Int :=
  x * Int.ofNat (2 ^ shift)

def leftShift {n : Nat} (a : Vector Int n) (b : Vector Nat n)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin n, b[i] < 64) : Vector Int n :=
  Vector.ofFn fun i => shiftLeftInt (a[i]) (b[i])

theorem leftShift_spec {n : Nat} (a : Vector Int n) (b : Vector Nat n)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin n, b[i] < 64) :
  (leftShift a b h).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, (leftShift a b h)[i] = shiftLeftInt (a[i]) (b[i]) := by
  -- Unfold definition
  dsimp [leftShift]
  constructor
  · -- length of Vector.ofFn ... .toList is n
    -- `Vector.ofFn` produces a vector of length `n`, so its `toList` has length `n`.
    -- `simp` unfolds the definitions to reduce to `rfl`.
    simp
  · intro i
    -- element-wise equality: (Vector.ofFn f)[i] = f i
    simp

def less {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) : Vector Bool n :=
  Vector.ofFn fun i => decide (a[i] < b[i])

theorem less_spec {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) :
  (less a b).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, (less a b)[i] = (a[i] < b[i]) := by
  dsimp [less]
  constructor
  · -- length
    simp
  · -- pointwise equality
    intro i
    simp

def lessEqual {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) : Vector Bool n :=
  Vector.ofFn fun i => a[i] ≤ b[i]

theorem lessEqual_spec {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) :
  (lessEqual a b).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, (lessEqual a b)[i] = (a[i] ≤ b[i]) := by
  constructor
  · dsimp [lessEqual]
    -- Vector.ofFn produces a vector of length n
    -- toList.length simplifies to n
    simp [Vector.ofFn]
  · intro i
    dsimp [lessEqual]
    simp [Vector.ofFn]

def NonZeroVector (n : Nat) := { v : Vector Int n // ∀ i : Fin n, v[i] ≠ 0 }

def mod {n : Nat} (a : Vector Int n) (b : NonZeroVector n) : Vector Int n :=
  Vector.ofFn fun i => a[i] % (b.val[i])

theorem mod_spec {n : Nat} (a : Vector Int n) (b : NonZeroVector n) :
  (mod a b).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, (mod a b)[i] = a[i] % (b.val[i]) := by
  dsimp [mod]
  constructor
  · simp
  · intro i; simp

def polyder {n : Nat} (poly : Vector Float n) (m : Int) : Vector Float (n - m.natAbs) :=
  Vector.replicate (n - m.natAbs) 0.0

theorem polyder_spec {n : Nat} (poly : Vector Float n) (m : Int)
  (h : m > 0) :
  let ret := polyder poly m
  ret.toList.length = n - m.natAbs := by
  dsimp [polyder]
  simp [Vector.toList_replicate, List.length_replicate]

def remainder {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) : Vector Int n :=
  Vector.ofFn fun i => a[i] % b[i]

theorem remainder_spec {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n)
  (h : ∀ i : Fin n, b[i] ≠ 0) :
  let ret := remainder a b
  (ret.toList.length = n) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, ret[i] = a[i] % b[i]) := by
  dsimp [remainder]
  constructor
  · simp
  · intro i; simp

-- <vc-preamble>
def shiftRightInt (x : Int) (n : Nat) : Int :=
  if x ≥ 0 then
    Int.ofNat (x.natAbs >>> n)
  else
    -(Int.ofNat (((-x).natAbs - 1) >>> n + 1))
-- </vc-preamble>

-- <vc-helpers>
-- </vc-helpers>

-- <vc-definitions>
def rightShift {n : Nat} (a : Vector Int n) (b : Vector Nat n)
  (h : ∀ i : Fin n, b[i] < 64) : Vector Int n :=
  Vector.ofFn fun i => shiftRightInt (a[i]) (b[i])
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem rightShift_spec {n : Nat} (a : Vector Int n) (b : Vector Nat n)
  (h : ∀ i : Fin n, b[i] < 64) :
  (rightShift a b h).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, (rightShift a b h)[i] = shiftRightInt (a[i]) (b[i]) := by
  dsimp [rightShift]
  constructor
  · simp
  · intro i; simp
-- </vc-theorems>

def subtract {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) : Vector Int n :=
  Vector.ofFn fun i => a[i] - b[i]

theorem subtract_spec {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) :
  (subtract a b).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, (subtract a b)[i] = a[i] - b[i] := by
  dsimp [subtract]
  constructor
  · -- length
    -- `simp` unfolds `Vector.ofFn`/`List.ofFn` facts yielding the length `n`
    simp
  · -- pointwise equality
    intro i
    -- `simp` uses `ofFn_get` / `Vector.ofFn` behavior
    simp
